title: Proposed study collaboration on KRAS-related RASopathies

sentences.text: Invitation to discuss a research collaboration on KRAS-related RASopathies
Dear RASopathies Network team, your network serves people with all RASopathies, including KRAS-related conditions.
I am [name, role, institution], and I would welcome your thoughts on a study idea.
Published work links KRAS-related RASopathies to gain of function, with hyperactive Ras signalling.
A recruiting observational study covers children and adults with RASopathies.
Your contact registry, the PATRAS registry and the CITIZEN CFC registry may include KRAS families, although their pages do not name the gene.
Several trials, including MEK inhibitor studies in RASopathy heart disease, enrol by syndrome rather than by KRAS, so the gene link is less certain.
We would propose [study aim and design], shaped with families and run under ethics approval.

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be willing to discuss the idea, and how your registry or community might take part with proper consent?
We are not asking for any names, contact details or records of patients or families.
If this interests you, could we arrange a short call?
Thank you for your time and for your work with families.
